percentile: nearest rank ceil(0.95*n), n >= 40; max reported separately
operatorDay: S9: operator use on ludovico for one day with the panel; cannot be replaced by synthetic measurement
timing: One ordinary production build, startup-only URL switch; fresh contexts, interleaved arms; no differential checker during timing
paint: Trusted click timestamp to the first Chromium Paint event after the selected DOM state; two-rAF marker retained separately as a conservative proxy
cpu: Union of synchronous runtime batch, replica delivery, and lazy derivation intervals; no addition of nested intervals, RAF wait, or IndexedDB request latency
scope: Measurement files only; no product edits
